# WeldConstraint

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("WeldConstraint")`

Holds one part at the offset from another that the two have when the weld is enabled. It behaves like a `Weld`, but the offset is captured from where the parts are instead of being set through `C0` and `C1`. Use it to join two parts that are already in the right place.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Active` | `boolean` | — | read-only | Whether the weld is currently holding: it is enabled, both parts are set, and both are in the world. A weld with one part missing is not an error; it is inactive until the other part is set. |
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the weld holds. Each time it changes from false to true, the offset between the parts is captured again. To weld a part somewhere else, disable the weld, move the part and enable it again. |
| `Part0` | `BasePart?` | — | read/write | The part that `Part1` follows. |
| `Part1` | `BasePart?` | — | read/write | The part that follows `Part0`. |
